description: Add a hotfix: a bug the Developer wants fixed before any other work, often from a customer report. Pass the report word for word. It goes at the top of the Roadmap with two Tasks (a test that shows the bug, then the fix), and every Session is told it is waiting until one claims it. With claim: true, claim it now; otherwise finish the step you are on first, then claim it.

claim.description: Claim the hotfix straight away, to start on it now.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

report.description: The bug report as the Developer or customer wrote it: what goes wrong, and how to make it happen if known.

title.description: A few words naming the bug; the report's first line when left out.

name: add_hotfix
title: Add hotfix
